operations description: Join nhid.duckdb.NHID_GY40_T1 to nhid.duckdb.NHID_GY20_T1 on KEY_SEQ. Filter rows where SICK_SYM equals 'I10'. Union with nhid.duckdb.NHID_GY20_T1 rows where MAIN_SICK equals 'I10' or SUB_SICK equals 'I10'. Aggregate to one row per PERSON_ID by selecting the minimum RECU_FR_DT as the hypertension diagnosis date.

step_name: Drug Prescription Extraction and Class Mapping
operations description: Join nhid.duckdb.NHID_GY60_T1 to nhid.duckdb.NHID_GY20_T1 on KEY_SEQ. Filter rows where the first four characters of GNL_NM_CD match doi.gnl_nm_cd_4. Join the result with drug.duckdb.doi on the matched drug code to retrieve the group column (1 for CCB, 0 for DU). Aggregate to one row per PERSON_ID and RECU_FR_DT by selecting the maximum KEY_SEQ to resolve duplicate claim identifiers for the same date.

step_name: Index Date Identification and Exposure Classification
operations description: Filter prescriptions where RECU_FR_DT falls between 2003 and 2012 inclusive. For each PERSON_ID, identify the earliest RECU_FR_DT. Group by PERSON_ID and earliest date to detect simultaneous prescriptions of both CCB and DU. Apply an exclusion rule to drop PERSON_IDs with multiple group values on the same date. Aggregate to one row per PERSON_ID retaining the earliest date and corresponding group as exposure_class.

step_name: Baseline Period Definition and Prior Exclusion
operations description: Calculate the baseline start date as index_date minus 365 days. Filter drug_prescriptions_mapped for prescriptions occurring in 2002 or within the baseline period. Aggregate to one row per PERSON_ID with a binary indicator for prior CCB or DU use. Exclude PERSON_IDs where the indicator equals 1.

Join nhid.duckdb.NHID_GY40_T1 to nhid.duckdb.NHID_GY20_T1 on KEY_SEQ. Filter for diagnosis codes in SICK_SYM, MAIN_SICK, or SUB_SICK matching the specified fracture prefixes (S02, S07, S12, S22, S23, S42, S52, S62, S72, S82, S92) within the baseline period. Aggregate to one row per PERSON_ID with a binary indicator for baseline fracture presence. Exclude PERSON_IDs where the indicator equals 1.

For each PERSON_ID, determine the set of calendar years overlapping the 365-day baseline period. Join with nhid.duckdb.NHID_JK on PERSON_ID and match STND_Y to each required calendar year. Aggregate to one row per PERSON_ID by verifying coverage for all overlapping years. Exclude PERSON_IDs missing STND_Y for any overlapping year.

Join nhid.duckdb.NHID_JK to eligible_cohort_base on PERSON_ID. Extract SEX, AGE_GROUP, CTRB_PT_TYPE_CD, and DFAB_GRD_CD. Aggregate to one row per PERSON_ID by selecting the record with the STND_Y closest to the index date.

Join nhid.duckdb.NHID_GY40_T1 to nhid.duckdb.NHID_GY20_T1 on KEY_SEQ. Filter for diagnosis codes in SICK_SYM, MAIN_SICK, or SUB_SICK that match drug.duckdb.comor.code within the baseline period. Aggregate to one row per PERSON_ID by creating a binary indicator for each mapped comorbidity code.

Join nhid.duckdb.NHID_GY60_T1 to nhid.duckdb.NHID_GY20_T1 on KEY_SEQ. Filter for drug codes in GNL_NM_CD that match drug.duckdb.comedi.code within the baseline period. Aggregate to one row per PERSON_ID by creating a binary indicator for each mapped concomitant medication code.
Count the number of claims in nhid.duckdb.NHID_GY20_T1 within the baseline period per PERSON_ID. Aggregate to one row per PERSON_ID with the total claim count.

Perform LEFT JOINs of baseline_demographics, baseline_comorbidities, baseline_concomitant_meds, and baseline_healthcare_utilization to eligible_cohort_base on PERSON_ID. Replace NULL values for binary indicators and claim counts with 0. Ensure the final table contains exactly one row per PERSON_ID with the index date, exposure class, and all baseline covariates.
